verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe…
verses.english: Then a mendicant went up to the Buddha

verses.pali: ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:

verses.english: “Sir, they speak of this thing called ‘ignorance’.
And how is an ignoramus defined?”

verses.pali: “Idha, bhikkhu, assutavā puthujjano rūpaṁ nappajānāti, rūpasamudayaṁ nappajānāti, rūpanirodhaṁ nappajānāti, rūpanirodhagāminiṁ paṭipadaṁ nappajānāti;
verses.english: “Mendicant, it’s when an unlearned ordinary person doesn’t understand form, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation.
consciousness, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation.
And this is how an ignoramus is defined.”
